description: Generate a grocery shopping list scaled to people, days and meals — with quantities, categories and your own custom items.

faqs.a: Staple quantities are computed per person per day (e.g. ~0.5 kg vegetables daily) and rounded to sensible shopping units.
Yes — add any item with your own quantity in the custom section and it appears in the list and download.
faqs.q: Can I add my own items?

faqs.a: Uncheck any meal type and its ingredients are excluded from the generated list.
faqs.q: What if I skip a meal?

faqs.a: Everything runs locally in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

howto: Enter the number of people and days, and tick the meals you cook.
Pick a diet preference to filter the items.
Generate the list, add custom items, then download or copy it for shopping.
title: Grocery List Generator
